title.zh: 中国台湾地区封锁Coinbase及Kalshi网站，指其涉嫌违反选举博彩规定
title.en: 中国台湾地区封锁Coinbase及Kalshi网站，指其涉嫌违反选举博彩规定

current_state.zh: Taiwanese authorities, acting on a court order from New Taipei, blocked access to Coinbase and Kalshi over alleged violations of election-gambling laws ahead of the November 28 local elections, with users reporting loss of access since Wednesday and Polymarket already blocked in the region.
